workflow: A build-time execution enables optional optimization under memory-leak instrumentation.
Processing an input reaches the optimizer, which allocates a generated execution object.
The successful processing path exits without releasing that generated object.
Leak detection reports the residual allocation as fatal, causing the build step to fail instead of completing.
summary: Optimized execution object leaked during build-time processing
decision_reason: The failure mechanism materially matches the existing cluster: optimized execution allocates generated objects that are not released, and leak detection turns the residual allocations into a process failure. The differing build-time context and per-input executions do not change the underlying cause
